description: Clicking the link of the page already shown navigates in place and keeps a component's default that the server markup never sets, so a label shown by default stays shown

browserSteps.value: The label shows by its default and the component reflects that default as an attribute

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const label = document.querySelector('page-label'); const text = label && label.shadowRoot && label.shadowRoot.querySelector('.page-label-text'); if (text && text.textContent.trim() === 'Page 1 of 3' && label.hasAttribute('show_page_info')) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the label did not show Page 1 of 3 with its show_page_info attribute')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
Click the link of the page already shown

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { if (window.__navigations >= 1) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the same-page navigation did not complete')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })

if (window.__spaMarker !== 'kept') { throw new Error('the page reloaded instead of navigating in place'); } if (document.querySelector('page-label') !== window.__labelNode) { throw new Error('the component was replaced instead of morphed'); }

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const settle = performance.now() + 300; const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const label = document.querySelector('page-label'); const text = label.shadowRoot && label.shadowRoot.querySelector('.page-label-text'); const shown = Boolean(text && text.textContent.trim() === 'Page 1 of 3'); if (!shown || !label.hasAttribute('show_page_info')) { reject(new Error('after the same-page navigation the label is gone; attributes: ' + label.getAttributeNames().join(' '))); return; } if (performance.now() > settle) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('timed out')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
Navigating to another page and back still shows the label

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { const label = document.querySelector('page-label'); const text = label && label.shadowRoot && label.shadowRoot.querySelector('.page-label-text'); if (text && text.textContent.trim() === 'Page 1 of 3') { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the label did not show after navigating back')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 50); }; poll(); })
